scope: Negative UAT, XSS/import and object/authorization abuse tests for every enabled surface in the local single-operator profile, with the security matrix and threat model. No certification, public-ingress, multi-tenant or release claim.
source_identity_algorithm: scripts/source_identity.py: sorted tracked/untracked non-ignored paths excluding SHA256SUMS.txt and docs/evidence/, path NUL sha256(bytes), then sha256 of the concatenation

composition.audit_sources: Read cmd/miragemesh HTTP handlers and CLI modes, scripts/serve-web.mjs static/proxy/triage paths and apps/web React rendering before writing tests; tests/release/security-matrix.md maps 16 enabled surfaces to exact executable anchors.
composition.browser_boundary: tests/browser/security.spec.ts starts the real local web/engine process pair with scripts/start-local.mjs and sends raw HTTP for Host/Origin, method, media, key, body-size, object-path and replay cases.
composition.triage_data: Real C05/C16 incident state seeded by the existing C22 synthetic fixture generator; segment files are byte-compared before and after every rejected request.
composition.rendering: Stored triage reason and hostile filename rendered by the real React bundle under the shipped CSP; no innerHTML, eval or external request is used.
composition.engine_coverage: Every engine/CLI/storage row points at an exact existing Go, Node or browser anchor that ran in this source's required suites; C27 adds no duplicate engine harness.
composition.egress: CSP blocks external fetch in the browser; existing import-boundary and rootless-container anchors remain the engine-side egress proof in the same suite.

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic security metadata, hostile import payloads and expected statuses. No real traffic, credentials, incident text, customer data or private material.
fixtures.bounds_provenance: 1 MiB preview, 16 KiB triage body, 16-128 rune idempotency key and loopback-only binding are the existing implemented limits, not capacity measurements.

results: Web shell: every served path returned the shipped CSP (default-src 'none', script-src 'self', connect-src 'self', frame-ancestors 'none'), nosniff, DENY framing, no-referrer, no-store and the four documented runtime-config keys; inline script insertion did not execute and an external fetch was blocked.

Static confinement: six traversal/encoded/symlink-adjacent paths (/assets/../../etc/passwd, %2e%2e and ..%5c variants, /ops/web/runtime-config.json, /.env, /package.json) returned 400/404 without exposing sentinel content.

Host and Origin: four forged Host/Origin variants were rejected on /healthz with the expected 403 before any data response; the existing Node and Go anchors cover the same check on every loopback surface.

Disabled surfaces: /api/v1/incidents, /api/v1/sensors, /api/v1/certificates and /api/v1/updates returned their exact typed 503 bodies; POST to each read API returned 405 with Allow: GET; triage on a disabled engine returned 503.

Triage authorization: missing/foreign/null Origin, wrong media type, missing or short idempotency key, 16 KiB+1 body, GET, unknown object, malformed object and an extra body field were rejected with their exact status/error; incident history counts and every segment file byte were unchanged.

Triage acceptance and replay: one same-origin request appended exactly one history entry (202, replayed=false); repeating the same key returned 202 replayed=true with no additional entry, preserving the C22 lost-response behavior.

Stored XSS: a hostile triage reason, hostile upload filename and hostile JSON keys rendered as inert text at 360px; no img/script/svg node was created, no sentinel global was set, no page error occurred and no non-loopback request was made.
JSON import: a 1 MiB+1 file was rejected before preview, __proto__ was rejected as an unsafe key, and the hostile filename was displayed as text only.

Engine and CLI surfaces: the matrix binds mTLS identity, update authority, certificate rotation, decoy isolation/provider ownership, storage/index integrity, retention and CLI file authority, and no-egress rows to exact required Go, Node and browser anchors that passed in this source's suites.

Findings: no critical or high severity finding remains in the audited local profile; four low observations are documented (inline style allowance, local-user loopback reachability, read APIs without per-request auth, absent COOP/CORP).

Matrix coverage: 16 enabled surfaces, each with entry points, boundary assumption, exercised threats, control, executable proof and result in tests/release/security-matrix.md; threat model and explicit limits in docs/security/THREAT_MODEL.md.
observed_limitations: Local Linux single-operator profile only. The matrix is not a penetration-test certification, no-vulnerability statement, or proof against OS compromise, physical access or a malicious local user with the same account.
No public ingress, hosted multi-tenant authorization or production identity provider was available or tested; ADR-0003 excludes those from this profile.
Read APIs rely on loopback binding plus Host/Origin checks; they carry no per-request authentication. This is a documented low observation, not a fix.
The browser suite used Chromium through the repository Playwright configuration only; no Firefox/WebKit claim is made.
The triage fixture seeds incidents through the existing C22 synthetic generator; no real incident data was used.
Hosted GitHub Actions were not run for this source; no push, deployment, release or publication occurred.
Local npm is 11.17.0 while package.json pins packageManager npm@11.9.0; node and Go match their locks.
The audited identity was computed after the implementation commit aadbb337; the later evidence/progress/handoff bookkeeping commit changes planning metadata only and carries no runtime claim.
C28 measured hardware, C30 clean-host core workflow/restart/restore and C40 published artifacts remain open.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: The change is additive test, fixture and documentation material; no stored format, API contract or protected file changed. Reverting the two C27 commits restores the prior source without touching accepted C05/C16/C22 data.
negatives_executed: replayed idempotency key without duplicate history
